title: Nested Loop Brute Force Search
pattern_description: Comparing every pair of elements using nested iterations resulting in O(n²) quadratic runtime.
recommendation: Check if a Hash Map (O(n) time, O(n) space) or Two-Pointer technique on a sorted array can reduce complexity from O(n²) to O(n) or O(n log n).

title: Two Pointers Technique
pattern_description: Using two pointers (left and right or fast and slow) to iterate through a sequence in linear time.
recommendation: Ensure pointer increments and decrements cannot cross each other infinitely or cause off-by-one errors.

title: Binary Search Pattern
pattern_description: Repeatedly dividing a sorted search space in half to achieve logarithmic runtime search O(log n).
key_edge_cases: integer overflow in mid calculation (low + (high - low) / 2)
recommendation: Use `mid = low + (high - low) / 2` to prevent potential integer overflow in languages like C++ and Java.

title: Sliding Window Pattern
pattern_description: Maintaining a dynamic window over array/string contiguous subarrays to compute running aggregates.
key_edge_cases: window size larger than input length
recommendation: Shrink window left boundary while window constraints are violated before expanding right boundary.

title: Hash Map Lookups & Frequency Counting
pattern_description: Using a hash table or dictionary for O(1) average time lookups, duplicate detection, and frequency count.
recommendation: Always verify key existence before accessing map values to prevent runtime KeyErrors or default insertions.
